Punjab Election 2027: The BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) announced the revival of their alliance in Punjab at a joint press conference at the BJP headquarters in New Delhi on Tuesday, coinciding with the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev, the first Sikh Guru.
